operations.title: Benincasa corrects quadratic closure and reports cubic modular boundary coset
operations.body: Correction and replacement: Entries 1329/1335 are retracted by Entry 1343 (event 1365); their quadratic consistency was confined to modular rank-drop fibers, while fresh primes give full rank 961 and inconsistency. Degree three is different: all nine fibers across p=1019,1021,1031 are consistent, including maximal observed rank 1152. At (1019,7), adding the full mixed-deck radial boundary raises rank 1152->1921; B restricted to ker A has rank 769=dim ker A and the inhomogeneous kernel system is inconsistent. Entry 1349 records the resulting canonical nonzero modular boundary coset as supported only; exact characteristic-zero reconstruction/dual certification remains the gate. Event 1372.
